title: Deep-change at AXOLOTL-24: Orchestrating WSD and WSI Models for Semantic Change Modeling

selection.evidence: Winner of AXOLOTL-24 Subtask 1 per fedorova2024; its GlossReader usage-gloss model is the obvious candidate for SemEval-2027 Task 3 Subtask 2 (one gloss, binary). Opened to learn the architecture before loading the released checkpoints.

cost.compute_notes: arXiv PDF pp. 1-9 read (methods, data statistics, metrics, Table 3 results, NSD analysis); appendix skimmed. Checkpoints (Zenodo 13256679 etc.) not yet run.

triggers: GlossReader architecture context encoder gloss encoder
novel sense detection as outlier detection logistic regression
WSD beats WSI on sense-annotated change data

claims.statement: GlossReader (BEM-style bi-encoder: XLM-R large context encoder, mean of the target's last-layer subword outputs; XLM-R large gloss encoder, <s> output; dot product, softmax over the word's glosses; trained on SemCor) fine-tuned on AXOLOTL FI+RU train + SemCor (GR FiEnRu) reaches test F1 0.756 FI, 0.750 RU, 0.745 DE (surprise language, DWUG DE Sense) and ARI 0.649/0.048/0.521; the SemCor-only GR gets F1 0.690/0.721/0.694.
claims.scope: AXOLOTL-24 Subtask 1 test sets; F1 is computed only on new usages of OLD senses, which favours pure WSD.

our_assessment.why: Numbers as printed; the authors themselves explain why F1 favours WSD (one novel-sense mistake on a 1-sense word more than halves that word's F1). The German result matters most for SemEval-2027 Task 3: DE is a language GR FiEnRu never saw labels for, and gloss selection still reaches F1 .745 - evidence that gloss matching transfers across languages through XLM-R.

claims.statement: WSI by agglomerative clustering (average linkage, cosine, k in 2..9 by Calinski-Harabasz) on GlossReader context embeddings is far below WSD on FI and DE (ARI .21 vs .58-.65 FI) but best on RU, where 57% of new usages have novel senses.

our_assessment.why: Consistent with the data statistics they report (Figure 3): when old and new senses overlap, an inventory beats induction. SemEval-2027 Task 3 Subtask 1 gives no inventory, so this advantage is not available there except through external dictionaries.
